tools.name: get_message_trail
tools.description: Returns a Message trail by its correlation ID: each hop with its flow, time, duration, outcome, failure code and the Logic App run it was, and the business keys the trail carried. Never a message body.

tools.name: get_run
tools.description: Returns a Logic App run: its status and its steps with status, duration and error. Never a step's input or output.

tools.name: list_failed_runs
tools.description: Lists the Logic App runs that failed in the last 24 hours, newest first: each with its flow, start time, failing step and error, the Logic App run it was (when there is one) and the correlation ID of its Message trail. Never a step's input or output.

tools.name: list_dead_letter_queues
tools.description: Lists every Service Bus queue and subscription with the count of its dead-lettered messages and the age in seconds of the oldest. Subscriptions are named topic/subscription.

tools.name: peek_dead_letters
tools.description: Peeks the oldest dead-lettered messages of one queue or subscription (named as list_dead_letter_queues names it) without receiving them, so the queue is unchanged: each with its sequence number, enqueued time, dead-letter reason and description, delivery count, application properties, correlation ID and business keys. Never a message body.
